title: The Founding Identity: How Sunrisers Hyderabad Became More Than an IPL Entry
dek: Every franchise starts with a first season and a first squad. Sunrisers Hyderabad's began in 2013; what that year looked like still shapes how they are seen.
excerpt: Sunrisers Hyderabad played their first season in 2013, led by S Dhawan with the bat and A Mishra with the ball. Some of that first squad stayed long enough to become the franchise's foundation.

sections.heading: More Than an Entry
body: A franchise becomes more than a team in a league when it builds continuity: players, a home ground and a recognisable way of playing that outlast a single season.

sections.heading: What the First Season Did Not Decide
body: First seasons are not destiny. Results, squads and owners change; the founding year is a starting point, not a prediction.
The later history of SRH is told season by season elsewhere in this series.
